item.description: In the software development department, we are building open source software that impacts one of the most visited websites in the world. Your work will help to improve our products’ usability and usefulness for readers and editors in the Wikimedia communities. We are looking for an UX intern (m/f) to join our Software Engineering team in our office at the heart of Berlin. We are open to discuss possibilities to work remotely. You will work closely with our UX designer/researcher."
item.content:encoded:
Organization: Wikimedia Deutschland e. V.

Status: filled

Compensation: paid

In the software development department, we are building open source software that impacts one of the most visited websites in the world. Your work will help to improve our products’ usability and usefulness for readers and editors in the Wikimedia communities.

We are looking for an UX intern (m/f) to join our Software Engineering team in our office at the heart of Berlin. We are open to discuss possibilities to work remotely. You will work closely with our UX designer/researcher."

How to Apply:

  • To begin your application, please visit https://www.software.wikimedia.de/jobs/ux-intern Please apply with your CV, work examples and your desired period of internship.
  • Prior to applying, please visit our website for more information on the internship: https://www.software.wikimedia.de/jobs/ux-intern
